description: Native voice dictation powered by a shared Rust engine
pre_install: if ($global) { throw 'NanoDictate installs per user only; rerun without --global.' }

if ($cmd -eq 'update') { $root = Join-Path $scoopdir 'apps\nanodictate\'; Get-Process -Name 'NanoDictate.App' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Path -and $_.Path.StartsWith($root, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) } | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction Stop }
post_install: $exe = Join-Path $dir 'NanoDictate.App.exe'; if (!(Test-Path $exe)) { throw 'Installed NanoDictate executable missing' }
pre_uninstall: if ($cmd -eq 'uninstall') { $key = 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run'; $value = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $key -Name 'NanoDictate' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).NanoDictate; if ($value -and $value.Contains($scoopdir)) { Remove-ItemProperty -Path $key -Name 'NanoDictate' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; $root = Join-Path $scoopdir 'apps\nanodictate\'; Get-Process -Name 'NanoDictate.App' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Path -and $_.Path.StartsWith($root, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) } | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction Stop }
